annotations.title: Texas $125,000 business personal property exemption test

description: Test each Texas business location against the $125,000 business personal property exemption and estimate the tax on the rest. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

exemption.description: Exemption per location in each taxing unit (US dollars). Texas exempts up to this much income-producing business personal property at each separate location in a taxing unit. Official reference value 125000 USD from Texas HB 9 (89th Legislature), amending Tax Code §11.145, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

locations.description: Locations. One row per separate location in the same taxing units. Do not combine locations.

label.description: Location reference label (no addresses needed). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for location reference label (no addresses needed). Unknown is not the same as zero. Optional reference label; no names or personal data.

value.description: Market value of business personal property at this location (US dollars). Total market value of all taxable business personal property at this location, including that of related businesses at the same location.

taxRate.description: Combined tax rate per $100 of taxable value (your figure) (per $100). Add the rates of the taxing units (county, city, school district and others) where the property is located. Your appraisal district or tax office lists them.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_texas_125_000_business_personal_property_exemption_test

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
